thread_title: What "Normal" people use these plants for
breadcrumb: What "Normal" people use these plants for

posts.body_html:
I guess when you're a Sarracenia nerd, you don't see these plants in the same light as non-Sarr nerds. Back in the 1980's or 1990's, I remember seeing a movie where some people were at a restaurant and every table had a vase filled with cut pitchers of S. leucophylla.

Well, we've stepped up our game since the 90's and now we got S. 'Legacy', minor okee giant Charlton Co, GA, , S. 'Bouquet', S. leuco var. alba yellow flower (MKL042), hurricane creek white, S. leuco pink x minor giant pink clone, Wilkerson's red rocket, etc. as cut "flowers":



I was going to give someone a dollar if they could name every clone in the bouquet, but realized it's hard to see every pitcher....
